messages:
alex: heads-up — python onboarding sample (bulk-embed import) hit simultaneous 401s then a wave of 429s during a customer demo.
viv: logs?
alex: paste: ```
2028-01-15T18:03:12Z INFO page=1 sent=50
2028-01-15T18:03:13Z WARN token refresh start (request=23)
2028-01-15T18:03:13Z WARN token refresh start (request=24)
2028-01-15T18:03:13Z WARN token refresh start (request=25)
2028-01-15T18:03:14Z ERROR page=2 status=401 body="token expired"
2028-01-15T18:03:14Z ERROR page=2 retry -> 429
2028-01-15T18:03:14Z ERROR page=3 status=429 body="rate limit"
```
alex: repro locally with python-sdk v0.9.7 and sample-app v3.1. default page_size=500 concurrency=12.
samir: interesting — python batcher groups by session_id only so multiple page workers merge into the same batch key and create bursts. plus token refresh is per-request (no singleflight) so we get a stampede.
viv: what's the batch key code now?
alex: snippet from client: ```py
key = f"{user_id}:{model}"  # cursor not included
# batcher maps key -> queue of requests to be flushed together
```
samir: that aligns with other SDK parity gaps. JS & Go added cursor into batch key for paginated flows last year. python missed that port.
qa-lyn: tests? we should add unit + e2e to prevent regressions. can add a stress test that spawns 6 page workers hitting same session id.
samir: proposed fixes: 1) include pagination cursor or page_index in batch key when opts.pagination is set, 2) add singleflight for token refresh so only one refresh happens at a time per client, 3) add small randomized jitter to retry backoff to avoid synchronized retries.
viv: example singleflight idea (async): ```py
class TokenRefresher:
    def __init__(self):
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._token_future = None

    async def refresh(self):
        async with self._lock:
            if self._token_future is None:
                self._token_future = asyncio.ensure_future(self._do_refresh())
        return await self._token_future
```
samir: and batch key patch: ```py
parts = [user_id, model]
if pagination and pagination.cursor:
    parts.append(f"cursor:{pagination.cursor}")
batch_key = "|".join(parts)
```
alex: immediate mitigation for the demo was to set PY_SDK_MAX_CONCURRENCY=3 which reduced inflight and avoided 401 storms. ops put an org-scoped override for the demo org.
qa-lyn: i'll add tests: unit for batch key parity, integration that runs sample-app with `--page-streams 4` and asserts no 401/429 pattern.
sdk-bot: opened issue DEVX-612: "python-sdk pagination batching + token refresh stampede" assigned to @samir.
ops-bot: feature-flag toggled for org demo-tenant -> python_sdk.reduce_concurrency=true
samir: i'll open a PR tonight with tests + changelog. plan to canary to staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: staging, image=python-sdk:fix-paginator-612, start=2028-01-16T09:00:00Z
alex: thanks team. i'll follow up with the customer once canary is green.
viv: also add a note in onboarding docs: "When importing large paginated datasets, enable pagination-aware batching or reduce client concurrency."
qa-lyn: adding doc note and sample-app flag `--pagination-aware-batching`.
